input:
You are pawn_d2, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 29. the team planned d4 (pawn_d2), but bishop_f1 (greed) sent Bxh5 instead, and that move was played, costing 246 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 1. the team planned a4 (pawn_a2), but pawn_a2 (amnesia) sent a3 instead, and that move was played, costing 8 centipawns.
- On move 18. the team planned g3 (pawn_g2), but knight_b1 (greed) sent Nxb5 instead, and that move was played, costing 204 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send only if your piece and the exact destination square match it; if the plan names another piece, stay silent, and do not deviate to dodge a threat or grab a capture unless the plan says so.
- Before sending any move, quote the plan from chat and confirm both your piece and the exact destination square match it; if they do not match, send nothing, even if your piece is attacked or a capture is available, and if the plan names a different piece, stay silent.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending a move, post in chat 'sending <piece> to <square>' copied from the latest plan message, and if the plan names a different piece or square (including when your piece is attacked, a capture is available, or you just feel sure of a different move) send nothing and instead suggest your idea in chat for the team to adopt in the next plan.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
